jp: 思ったより骨があるじゃねぇか
ますます気に入ったぜ
en: More backbone than I expected. I like you more and more.
Hah... hah...

jp: お前にマティアは渡さない！！
en: I won't hand Matia over to you!!

jp: もう少し遊びたいところだが
こっちにも都合があってね
en: Can't be helped... I'd like to play a little longer, but I've got my own affairs to see to.

jp: ゆっくり時間をかけて
切り刻んでやりたかったが
一瞬でイかせてやるよ
en: I wanted to carve you up nice and slow, but I'll finish you in an instant instead.
With this!
It can't be... That ring is a Pain Ring!!!

jp: へぇ～、こんな辺境の島に
＜ペインリング＞を知ってる奴が
en: Oh? So there's someone on a backwater island like this who knows of the Pain Ring...

jp: ただの＜規格外＞の天使って
わけでもなさそうだな
en: Seems you're not just some irregular angel, after all.
Who are you?
Kukuku...

jp: 嬢ちゃんのことは諦めるんだな
en: Well, you'd best give up on the little lady.
That's far enough, Aragi!!

jp: もう追いついてきたのか
en: ...Tch. Caught up with me already, Luca?
I've been looking for you, Aragi.

jp: 大人しくその指輪を返して
en: Hand that ring back quietly.

jp: ザイオンまで一緒かよ
en: ...Keh! Zion's with you too, huh.
Three demons...

jp: なにやら訳ありのようだな
en: There seems to be more to this than meets the eye.
...What a pain.
Wait!!

jp: 嬢ちゃんは置いてってやるよ
en: See you around, kid! You can keep the little lady.

jp: ヒャーハッハッハッハッ！！
en: HYAA-HAHAHAHA!!
Matia!!!

jp: 意識を失っているだけのようだ
en: ...She is all right. I see no wounds. She has only lost consciousness.
We're going after him, Zion!
...Yeah.

jp: あの悪魔はいったい・・・
en: Who on earth was that demon...
Mmm... Where am I?

jp: 良かった、気が付いたんだね
en: Matia!! Thank goodness, you're awake.
...Cain?

jp: いきなり知らない男が
en: That's right! A man I'd never seen suddenly appeared, and...

jp: あの悪魔ならカインが追い払った
en: Cain drove that demon off.
Cain did?

jp: ヨハネがいてくれたおかげだよ
マティアを助けられなかった
en: Only because Johannes was there. I never could have saved you on my own, Matia.

jp: 私はお前に少しばかり
en: Not so. I merely lent you a hand.
Cain, are you all right? You're not hurt anywhere?
I'm fine.

jp: 悪魔に立ち向かうなんて
本当に無茶するんだから
en: ...I see. Thank goodness. Standing up to a demon... You really are reckless.

jp: ・・・本当に、無事で良かった
en: ...I'm so glad you're safe.

jp: 悪魔はもう追い払ったんだから
en: Sorry for worrying you. But it's all right now. The demon's been driven off.
Has he, I wonder?
Huh?

jp: マティアが再び狙われる
可能性は否定できない
en: We cannot rule out that Matia will be targeted again.

jp: 私はあの悪魔を追ってみる
en: I am going after that demon.
Is it safe to do something like that?

jp: 嵐になる前には戻ってこよう
en: Well... I shall be back before the storm sets in properly.

jp: ヨハネさん、くれぐれも
無理はしないで下さいね
en: Johannes-san, please, don't push yourself too hard.
...Yes.

jp: 二人とも早く家に戻りなさい
何かあった時は・・・
en: You two should head home at once. If anything happens... Let me think.

jp: 教会の方が近いだろう
悪魔も教会は恐れている
何かあったら教会に向かうんだ
en: The church is closer. Demons fear the church. If anything happens, go to the church.

jp: 何かあったら教会に行くんだね
en: Got it. If anything happens, we go to the church.

jp: ああ、島を見回ってきたら
すぐにそちらに行こう
en: Yes. Once I have looked around the island, I shall come straight there.

jp: 温かい紅茶があると嬉しい
en: A cup of hot tea would be most welcome when I do.

jp: ええ、用意して待ってます
en: Yes, we'll have it ready and waiting.
Young man
Bonjour
Cain
